bullets.text: Workers panicked after a gas leak occurred at SIPCOT in Gummidipoondi, Thiruvallur, and the office should monitor containment measures.
A school van driver was arrested under the POCSO Act in Sengundram, Thiruvallur, for sexually harassing a 5-year-old girl, and the office must track police action.
Heavy rain lashed Chennai, and the meteorological department predicted heavy rain in eight districts tomorrow on Deepavali, requiring official vigilance.
Southern Railway is awaiting RDSO clearance to fix the train-platform gap at the newly constructed Adambakkam station, and the constituency team should monitor progress.
Power supply will be suspended in parts of Adambakkam on Friday for maintenance work, and the office should ensure public advisories are followed.
The Home Secretary transferred four police officers, including Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran, and the constituency team should note the administrative change.
A boiler tube puncture occurred in the second unit of the North Chennai Thermal Power Station in Athipattu, and the district team should track repair works.
Passengers at Avadi railway station raised concerns over delays in widening platform 4, and the district team should coordinate with railway authorities for expediting work.
Avadi and Tambaram City Police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized ganja and narcotics, and the office should acknowledge the anti-narcotics drive.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay ordered a Rs 2,000-crore allocation for the Vetri Laptop Scheme, and the portfolio team should oversee implementation.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by AMD GPUs, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure growth.
ELCOT MD B. Vishnu Chandran was appointed Chairman of Elnet Technologies, and the portfolio team should note the leadership change.
The Periyar Arivulagam book procurement controversy escalated as the government formed a panel to inspect libraries amid allegations, and the office should monitor political developments.
Minister Rajmohan alleged that an AI-related scam occurred during the previous DMK regime, and the office should watch further statements on the matter.
